summary.business_type: SaaS (Pilates studio management) + local marketplace component (Tentare Network)
top_findings: Homepage title/H1/meta says "en Barcelona" while the rest of the site (/funcionalidades, /comparativa, schema) is national in scope — two-way intent mismatch
/network/instructoras/ciudad/barcelona canonical tag points to the bare homepage instead of itself, risking full suppression from local search results
/network/instructoras/ciudad/barcelona is near-empty (40 words, 1 listing) and the URL pattern is designed to scale to more cities before the template is fixed
/network/instructoras has 2.5-3.5x elevated TTFB (450-640ms vs ~185ms baseline) — likely an uncached listing query
No owned round-up/comparison asset for broad commercial queries ("mejor software gestión pilates"), currently won by third-party listicles
quick_wins: Fix the canonical tag on /network/instructoras/ciudad/barcelona (one-line template fix)
Drop the city qualifier from the homepage title/H1/meta
Add ItemList schema to the marketplace listing/city pages
Give /network its own H1 instead of inheriting the generic SaaS hero
Populate lastmod on the 37 sitemap URLs currently missing it

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS + HSTS (2yr max-age)
X-Frame-Options: DENY + CSP frame-ancestors 'none'
Self-referencing canonicals consistent on www+https across the 6-page sample
Mobile viewport meta present
Clean URL structure across all 139 sitemap URLs (no trailing slashes, no query params, no uppercase, 100% www+https)
No redirect chains, no console errors observed
Server-rendered (not SPA) on every page sampled
Valid sitemap.xml, correct namespace, no size-limit issues

findings.title: robots.txt blanket Disallow: /network/ overridden by more-specific Allow rules — correct today, fragile for future routes
findings.description: Per real precedence rules (most-specific-wins), no sitemap URL is currently blocked, but any new /network/* route not covered by an explicit Allow would fall through to the blanket disallow.
findings.recommendation: Restructure to default-deny with explicit allow-listed public leaves instead of the current mixed ordering.

findings.title: 37 of 139 sitemap URLs (27%) have no lastmod, inconsistently within sections
findings.description: Google may stop trusting lastmod sitewide if it's unreliable a meaningful fraction of the time.
findings.recommendation: Populate lastmod from real content-store timestamps or drop the field entirely.

findings.title: HSTS missing includeSubDomains/preload
findings.description: Base directive present and long-lived; just missing the two optional directives.
findings.recommendation: Add includeSubDomains; preload if all subdomains are HTTPS-only.

findings.title: No X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff observed
findings.description: Standard defense-in-depth header missing on the homepage response.
findings.recommendation: Add the header.

findings.title: /reservar/<studio> booking-widget pages indexed with no robots.txt exclusion
findings.description: 4 pages today, one per signed customer; architectural note for product confirmation, not a defect.
findings.recommendation: Confirm this is intentional; monitor as the count grows with customer count.

findings.title: Broad Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on homepage HTML response
findings.description: Likely a CDN config artifact, not scoped to a specific route.
findings.recommendation: Confirm with tentare-seguridad it doesn't also apply to authenticated API responses.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: /precios: specific, falsifiable pricing claims (exact prices, exact limits, no vague marketing language)
/recursos/estudios-pilates-de-exito: well-sourced, dated, attributed external citations — strongest E-E-A-T page found
/comparativa/tentare-vs-bsport: unusually honest comparison, concedes ground to competitor, dated and disclaimed
/funcionalidades/sustituciones: concrete operational scenarios, discloses known limitations
/glosario: neutral, well-scoped definitions with cross-links
/ayuda/empezar/crear-tu-cuenta: byline + update date + human-support closer

findings.title: /network/instructoras/ciudad/barcelona is textbook thin/doorway-page risk
findings.description: Only 40 words extracted, mostly UI chrome; 1 listing. Confirmed independently by content, local, visual, and sxo agents.
findings.recommendation: Noindex until minimum inventory (e.g. 3+ instructors), or expand with genuinely unique local content.

findings.title: /comparativa/tentare-vs-bsport thin (214 words prose); cluster risk unverified across 12 other pages
findings.description: Extrapolation from 1 of 13 comparativa pages — if the other 12 follow the same template, near-duplicate content risk at scale.
findings.recommendation: Verify unique-content ratio across all 13 before concluding the cluster is fine.

findings.title: /soluciones/estudio-de-yoga thin content
findings.description: 197 words, well below the ~800-word floor for a commercial-intent solutions page.
findings.recommendation: Expand with yoga-specific detail or noindex/deprioritize if intentionally a placeholder.

findings.title: /ayuda/* cluster depth-vs-complexity not verified beyond 1 sample
findings.description: The sampled article (account creation) was appropriately scoped; more complex topics (billing, permissions) not checked.
findings.recommendation: Spot-check 3-5 more articles on complex topics.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: /comparativa/tentare-vs-X pages match the structural pattern seen in real competitor comparison SERPs
/recursos/* guides correctly typed as procedural how-to content

findings.title: Homepage geo-branding contradicts national SaaS scope
findings.description: Title/H1/meta say "en Barcelona" while /funcionalidades, /comparativa, and the SoftwareApplication schema (no LocalBusiness, no address/map) treat the product as national — a two-way intent mismatch confirmed by independent SXO analysis against real SERPs.
findings.recommendation: Drop the city qualifier from title/H1/meta (recommended, zero cost) or build genuine local-page signals if Barcelona-first is a deliberate strategy.

findings.title: /network hub H1 is the generic SaaS hero, not marketplace-relevant
findings.description: Only H1 is "Tu estudio, A OTRO NIVEL", unrelated to the instructor marketplace, Pilates/Yoga, or location.
findings.recommendation: Give /network its own H1 naming the marketplace and its core entities.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Rich, valid JSON-LD graph on homepage (SoftwareApplication+Offer, FAQPage, Organization+ContactPoint, WebSite+SearchAction, SiteNavigationElement)
Zero fabricated aggregateRating/Review anywhere checked — correct honest omission
Pricing in schema matches visible pricing
/glosario correctly uses DefinedTermSet/DefinedTerm
Instructor profile has real, non-fabricated Person schema with appropriate city-level-only address
BreadcrumbList present and correctly nested across /network

findings.title: Listing/city pages in /network lack ItemList schema
findings.description: Only BreadcrumbList present on listing and city pages; ItemList is the correct non-fabricated pattern for a directory listing.
findings.recommendation: Add ItemList with real ListItem entries only, before the directory scales.

findings.title: FAQPage schema present on homepage — no current Google SERP benefit
findings.description: Google retired FAQ rich results for all sites May 7 2026; markup is technically valid, just no longer produces a rich result.
findings.recommendation: No action required; don't invest further in expanding it for SERP purposes.

findings.title: 68% of the site's schema not independently verified
findings.description: Only home, precios (partial), funcionalidades (hub+1), comparativa (hub+1), glosario, and one network profile were checked.
findings.recommendation: Extend coverage in a follow-up pass, particularly /recursos and /ayuda.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Hero LCP candidate is a real, correctly preloaded , not the autoplay video (which loads below the fold with preload="metadata")
Self-hosted fonts via next/font, cached immutably — avoids third-party font-loading round trip
Zero third-party render-blocking scripts across the 5 pages checked
DOM size within budget (~1,100-1,300 elements) on all 5 pages checked
Explicit width/height on images that matter for CLS prevention
/_next/static/* assets (JS, fonts, optimized images) correctly cached immutable, max-age=31536000

findings.title: public/ static assets (video, posters, logo pieces) never cached by the browser
findings.description: cache-control: max-age=0, must-revalidate confirmed via curl -I on 5 files including ~1.8MB of video, unlike /_next/static/* which is immutable — forces revalidation every repeat visit.
findings.recommendation: Serve through the Next.js asset pipeline or add explicit long-lived Cache-Control headers with filename-hash cache-busting.

findings.title: 17 preloaded .woff2 files across 9 font families on the homepage
findings.description: All self-hosted and cached correctly, but 17 concurrent font preloads compete with the LCP image and critical CSS for early bandwidth.
findings.recommendation: Audit which fonts/weights are actually needed above the fold; lazy-load the rest.

findings.title: Cold-path TTFB substantially worse than warm-path on 2 of 5 routes
findings.description: Measured directly: /network/instructoras 1.96s (cold) vs 0.44-0.69s (warm); /funcionalidades/sustituciones 1.02s (cold) vs 0.12-0.33s (warm). Consistent with a serverless cold start or edge cache-miss on less-frequently-hit routes.
findings.recommendation: Check CrUX field TTFB for these two routes once an API key exists; consider ISR/static generation or edge caching for the instructor listing data fetch.

findings.title: Hero element lacks fetchPriority="high" on the tag itself
findings.description: Only the preload carries fetchPriority="high"; the tag doesn't, suggesting the Image component's priority prop may not be set.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the hero <Image> uses the priority prop.

findings.title: Homepage JS payload ~1.48MB uncompressed across 22 async chunks
findings.description: Not render-blocking (all async), but relevant main-thread weight for INP; not verified with a real browser in this environment.
findings.recommendation: No action needed unless a future Lighthouse/unlighthouse run shows a confirmed INP/TBT problem tied to this.

findings.title: Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) not measured — full field-data gap
findings.description: No Google API credentials; unlighthouse crashed twice on a sandbox resource constraint before reaching the Lighthouse-audit phase; no Chrome binary on PATH for standalone lighthouse CLI.
findings.recommendation: Configure PSI/CrUX API key or re-run unlighthouse/lighthouse on a machine with more headroom and a real Chrome install before drawing CWV pass/fail conclusions.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, etc.) allowed via blanket robots.txt Allow rule
Homepage server-rendered with rich JSON-LD entity signals
/glosario close to ideal citability format (short, self-contained, neutral definitions)
llms.txt/RSL absence correctly scored Low/Info, not treated as a real gap

findings.title: Passages shorter than optimal AI-citation length or buried in tables
findings.description: Glossary definitions run ~30-60 words vs the 134-167 word optimum; feature-page substance often locked in comparison tables rather than prose.
findings.recommendation: Add 130-170 word direct-answer paragraphs above tables on cornerstone pages.

findings.title: Off-page brand signals (YouTube, Reddit, Wikipedia, LinkedIn) unverified
findings.description: Not checkable with tools available in this session; YouTube presence has the single highest correlation with AI citation of any signal studied.
findings.recommendation: Verify actual presence on each platform (~1hr) before further GEO investment; a YouTube channel is the highest-leverage single addition if absent.

findings.title: Headings not consistently question-form
findings.description: Sampled H2s are declarative/marketing style rather than matching how users phrase AI prompts.
findings.recommendation: A/B question-form H2/H3 variants on cornerstone informational pages.

findings.title: Images category not audited in this pass
findings.description: No seo-images subagent was run; excluded from the health score rather than assigned a fabricated value.
findings.recommendation: Run /seo images tentare.app as a follow-up.

categories.name: Backlinks
what_works: No toxic or spam link signals found (vacuously, given no data)

findings.title: tentare.app not present in Common Crawl web graph
findings.description: Expected for a domain that opened to the public 2026-08-19; absence in one free dataset, not evidence of zero real backlinks. No Moz/Bing keys configured for a fuller check.
findings.recommendation: Optional: Moz free tier or Bing Webmaster Tools for actual visibility, not urgent.
